answer: Each agent files one wharf manifest with a 60-credit copper bond. The manifest lists copper received and crystal dispatched under a key-bound crystal seal on it. A wharf auditor recomputes stock, inflows, outflows; a mismatch burns the bond and voids the dispatch. Filing costs 50 plus 2 per earlier manifest, so the kth fake pays 110+2(k-1), the 1000th pays 2108, and 1000 fakes cost 1,109,000. An honest agent files once, pays 110, and recovers the copper bond. A rented-manifest ring fails at the wharf: a reused crystal seal appears in two manifests, so both bonds burn.
